newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 18.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Henri Konan Bedie urges Ivory Coast to become a nation of savers, saying this is the key to economic growth and development
- France and Francophone African air safety agency ASECNA hold seminar on use of satellites for airline navigation and communications
- Franco-Ivorian shipyard CARENA ends lockout in effort to woo striking employees back to work
- Secondary school teachers union SYNESCI launches 72-hour strike today Tuesday over pay and conditions
- Dakar-based Africa Centre for Monetary studies seeks new director. Candidates must be from countries belonging to the Association of African Central Banks. Closing date for applications March 21.
- Canada provides 1.5 billion CFA francs to help Ivory Coast develop non-traditional farm exports such as flowers and tobacco
- Experts from West African countries, meeting in Ivory Coast's capital Yamoussoukro, discuss response to soaring crime in their countries and across their common borders
